title: A target project of the delivery loop
description: platform/projects/<name>/project.yaml (design decision 10). Read by Plane's setup Job, the orchestrator, seed-projects.sh and Argo CD's ApplicationSets.

name.description: The project's name, also the directory's. It is the project's identity: the orchestrator's threads and ticket links name it, so renaming a project leaves its threads behind. It also names the project's Argo CD AppProject, hence never default, the platform's own.

tracker.description: The Plane project the loop takes tickets from.

identifier.description: Ticket keys and branch names start with it, such as EWA-12.

name.description: Plane allows no special characters in it.

gitea.description: owner/name on the platform's Gitea; target projects live in the sdlc organization.

clone.description: The local clone seed-projects.sh pushes when the repository is missing; ~ is the operator's home. <NAME>_CLONE in the environment overrides it, such as EXAMPLE_WEBAPP_CLONE.

base.description: Feature branches start here and merge back here.

release.description: Releases merge into this branch, which production runs.

domain.description: Production's host; dev is dev.<domain>, a preview <key>.qa.<domain>.

previews.description: A preview per pull request, at <id>.qa.<domain>, and the Deploying to QA phase: the orchestrator labels the pull request preview when the code is ready and waits for the preview to serve it. Off, an item goes from Implementing straight to Code review.

checks.description: Commands an implementation run must pass in the clone, in order, before it pushes, such as the tests.

plane.description: Plane username; it must not change across rebuilds.
